title: Remediate @sevenpico/cdk-construct-kms-key (PR #35 merged with QA CHANGES REQUESTED)
description:
PR #35 was merged while QA had CHANGES REQUESTED. The kms-key implementation passes tests but has weak CloudFormation assertions that would allow bugs to ship undetected. On develop branch, fix the following on feat/cdk-construct-kms-key-remediate:

QA issues found:
1. No non-default prop values tested — enableKeyRotation, pendingWindowInDays, removalPolicy, customAliasName all untested with override values
2. CloudFormation assertions are too weak / missing specific expected values

Fix:
- Add pure function unit tests for all overrideable props (enableKeyRotation: false, pendingWindowInDays: 14, etc.)
- Strengthen CDK Template assertions to assert actual CloudFormation prop values, not just resource existence
- Run all tests: cd packages/cdk-construct-kms-key && ../../node_modules/jest-cli/bin/jest.js --no-coverage
- Open a fix PR against develop
- Follow full PR workflow (code review + QA + lead engineer merge)
